topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: This isn't right. Found Gramps' old place, up on the fourth floor of a building that smells like yesterday’s cigarette smoke and worse. Pawn shop down on Main, where the neon flickers like forgotten dreams. There it was, in a display case, under a sheet of glass. Mama’s wedding band, or so it looked. The old man’s hand shook when he handed over the worn velvet box, eyes scanning the room like maybe the ghosts had something to say. I know this town, and it’s full of secrets sharp as broken glass. I’m keeping the ring safe, tucked away. Gotta figure out how it got there, and fast, before the night swallows what little light we have left.
